name: ceh-build-plan
description: CEH build plan: plan a change and build it from the plan. Decide how to build a new app or one feature before any code, as one committed plan file with scope, the design decisions the build needs, and phases that each end in a runnable check, and review the plan before anyone builds from it. Then build it phase by phase, test first, implementing only what each phase names and proving it with the phase's own check, with the evidence recorded in the plan.
